jobs.description: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst .    About RainFocus   RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting. About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one. \n Key Responsibilities: Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.   Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.   Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.   Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.   Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.   Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.   Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.   Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.   Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.   Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.   Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress. Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable. 6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field. In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others). Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist. Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable. Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus. Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.

jobs.description: The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image. Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich. jobs.title: Kaufmännische Geschäftsführung / COO (all genders), 80%
jobs.description: Reflecta demokratisiert den Zugang zu Netzwerk, Wissen und Fördermitteln. Seit 2010 bringen wir Menschen zusammen, die die Gesellschaft zukunftsfähig machen wollen: zunächst mit Offline-Formaten, seit 2019 digital. Heute ist Reflecta ein lernendes Ökosystem mit einer Community von über 10.000 Zukunftsgestalter:innen. Sein jüngstes Kapitel ist der Fördermittelkompass, die größte strukturierte Förderdatenbank im deutschsprachigen Raum, im Abo genutzt von Organisationen aus Zivilgesellschaft, Wohlfahrt, Kommunen und Unternehmen, dazu Landeseinrichtungen und Stiftungen über eigene Portale. Hinter dem Ökosystem steht eine gemeinnützige GmbH mit einem Team von sieben Personen, remote first und wachsend. Mit dem Wachstum teilen wir die Führung in klare Ressorts: Unsere Gründerin Daniela Mahr verantwortet die Gesamtvision, Partnerschaften und die Außenvertretung von Reflecta, Mitgründer und CTO Simon Franzen die technische Entwicklung. Wir suchen eine zweite Geschäftsführung, die die operative und kaufmännische Verantwortung übernimmt: Finanzen, Teamrhythmus und laufende Projekte. Du startest als COO mit dem klaren Ziel, als zweite Geschäftsführer:in bestellt zu werden. Aufgaben Finanzen verantworten: Budget, Liquiditätsplanung, Controlling. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatung (Jahresabschluss, Gemeinnützigkeit) und verantwortest die Abrechnung unserer Förderprojekte gegenüber öffentlichen und privaten Mittelgebern. Die vorbereitende Buchhaltung läuft schlank und zunehmend automatisiert; du verantwortest sie, verbesserst sie weiter und entscheidest mit, ob und wann eine unterstützende Office-Rolle dazukommt. Team führen: Wir arbeiten in Zwei-Wochen-Sprints. Du steuerst Planung, Review und die Aufgabenverteilung über alle laufenden Projekte und führst die Personalgespräche; über Neueinstellungen ins Team entscheiden wir gemeinsam. Du bist die Person, bei der die Fäden zusammenlaufen und du entwickelst unser Arbeitsformat weiter. Projekte steuern: Wir betreiben mehrere Plattformprojekte parallel (Fördermittelkompass, Partnerportale, geförderte Programme, Reflecta Netzwerk). Die strategischen Schwerpunkte setzen wir gemeinsam; innerhalb dieses Rahmens hältst du Zeitpläne, Kapazitäten und Zusagen im Blick und entscheidest, was wann Priorität hat. Die technische Entwicklung führt unser Mitgründer und CTO Simon, die Produktvision liegt bei Daniela. Verwaltung und Recht im Blick behalten: Verträge, Fristen, Registerpflichten, dazu ein überschaubarer Versicherungsbestand. Vieles davon ist digitalisiert; du trägst die Verantwortung und entscheidest, was du selbst machst, delegierst oder weiter automatisierst. Von Berlin aus arbeiten, remote first: Dein regelmäßiger Arbeitsort liegt in Deutschland; für zentrale Termine bist du regelmäßig in Berlin verfügbar und arbeitest wie wir alle überwiegend remote. Unser Büro in Berlin-Mitte steht dir offen. Du bist außerdem bei Branchen- und Netzwerk-Events für Reflecta unterwegs. Wenn du Lust auf Sichtbarkeit hast, auf Panels, Bühnen oder im Netzwerk unseres Sektors, gibt es dafür Raum. Wie wir uns die Außenwirkung aufteilen, entwickeln wir gemeinsam. jobs.title: Team Lead - Site Reliability Engineering (all genders)
jobs.description: Introduction FACT-Finder entwickelt Product-Discovery-Technologie für den eCommerce und ist mit den Produkten Next Generation und Infinity bei führenden Online-Shops in Europa im Einsatz. Aktuell modernisieren wir unser Hosting konsequent in Richtung Kubernetes auf Harvester – als on-prem Hybrid mit der Option, mittelfristig vollständig in die Cloud zu skalieren. Als Team Lead Site Reliability Engineering (all genders) verantwortest du Reliability, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten unserer Hosting-Umgebungen, treibst diese Transformation end-to-end voran und führst das Team, das sie umsetzt. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest die operative Gesundheit unseres Hostings über On-Premise (Frankfurt, Stockholm) und Cloud hinweg – Verfügbarkeit, Performance, Incident Management. Du treibst die Modernisierung in Richtung Kubernetes auf Harvester aktiv voran: Cluster-Topologie, Storage (Longhorn), Networking (VLAN, Load Balancing, Ingress), Backup und Disaster Recovery. Du baust eine produktionsreife k8s-Plattform auf: Lifecycle, Upgrades, RBAC, Secrets, GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), Observability und Policy-Guardrails. Du gestaltest den NG Search Operator (Custom Kubernetes Operator) und löst Auto-Scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, Cluster Autoscaler) für die aktuelle Architektur. Du definierst unser On-Prem-Hybrid-Modell konkret: welche Workloads laufen wo, wie burst’en wir in die Cloud, wie halten wir Latenz und Kosten im Griff – und hältst die Architektur portabel genug für einen späteren Cloud-Only-Schritt. Du verantwortest Kapazitätsplanung und Hosting-Kosten und machst Kosten zu einem gezielt steuerbaren Hebel. Du führst und entwickelst unser derzeit 4-köpfiges Hosting-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, verantwortest Performance und prägst die technische Standards- und Ownership-Kultur. Du machst AI zum festen Bestandteil unserer Operations: Diagnose, Automatisierung, Monitoring und Insight. Dein Profil Fundierter Hintergrund in Infrastructure oder Platform Engineering über On-Premise und Cloud hinweg. Hands-on Tiefe mit Kubernetes in Produktion: Cluster-Lifecycle, Upgrades, Networking, Storage, RBAC, Observability, GitOps-Delivery. Nachweislich starke Führungserfahrung, exzellente Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Harvester oder vergleichbaren HCI-/Virtualisierungsplattformen (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack). Erfahrung mit einer echten Migration von Bare Metal / klassischen VMs auf eine k8s-basierte Plattform – inklusive stateful Workloads, Storage-Migration, Cutover und Rollback. Sicherer Umgang mit Kubernetes Operators (Custom Controllers / CRDs), idealerweise für stateful Systeme wie Search, Datenbanken oder Streaming. Solides Verständnis von Auto-Scaling-Primitiven (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler, KEDA) und deren Zusammenspiel mit Kapazitätsplanung. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. The benefits Passion for languages: We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. Take a deep dive: As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. Teams who train together, stay together: We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. It takes a team to Tandem: Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. Balance matters: Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. Modern family: As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. Relocation without the stress: If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. Hybrid by design: We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitn

jobs.title: Office Assistant

We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses. The Role As Office Assistant, you'll be at the heart of algo1's day-to-day life. You'll be the first face visitors see when they walk through the door and a key part of what keeps the office running smoothly, from making sure meetings go well to keeping the space warm, tidy, and full of energy. What You'll Own Welcoming visitors. Welcome guests, clients, and important visitors into the office and make them feel at home. Supporting meetings. Offer drinks and assistance to visitors, and help meetings run smoothly. A well-run office. Keep the office and reception areas tidy, organised, and presentable throughout the day. Weekly ordering. About You Great with people. Approachable and professional in your interactions with visitors and colleagues, with strong communication skills. You take pride in making a great first impression. Organised and reliable. You keep on top of the details and are happy to roll your sleeves up and help wherever needed. Trustworthy. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity. At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions. Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts. The role Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team What we need from you You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required) Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus You communicate clearly and confidently in English What we offer Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro City center office location including home office option EGYM Wellpass membership support Educational budget for every employee Team events, summer & winter parties Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team Sounds good to you? jobs.description: Your creative field We are looking for two full-time , permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible . We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations. You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both. This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it. Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: Must have: • Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems • Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking • Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) • 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture • Fluent in German and English Should have: • Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools • Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices • Mentoring background Nice to have: • AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) We're filling this role at two levels. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. jobs.description: Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple. We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place. About the Role Joining our FP&A team as a Working Student, you won't just be doing basic data entry, you’ll have real ownership from day one. You’ll play a key role in strengthening our monthly financial reporting and budgeting processes across our PE-backed, multi-entity SaaS group. By consolidating costs and building clear, vendor-level insights, you will directly enable our budget owners to make smarter, faster decisions. What You’ll Do Drive Spend Transparency: Consolidate accounting cost data across multiple systems monthly, categorizing and tagging line items by vendor and cost type. Optimize Financial Models: Maintain and refine Excel models tracking actual spend against budget and forecast. Empower Budget Owners: Deliver clearer, more timely spend visibility to department heads to help optimize operational budgets. Automate & Improve: Leverage advanced Excel features, SQL, and PowerBI to automate recurring data flows, account reconciliations, and data validation. Innovate & Own: Proactively contribute ideas to streamline our processes, taking real ownership of your workstreams. What You Bring Academic Background: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Spreadsheet & Data Skills: Advanced Excel proficiency (XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, Power Query). Exposure to SQL, Snowflake, or PowerBI is a strong plus. Financial Basics: Solid understanding of financial accounting fundamentals (P&L structure, cost categorization, accruals logic). Detail & Precision: High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy across repetitive workflows. Language & Availability: Fluent in English (written and spoken). Based in Berlin and available to work 20 hours/week for at least 12 months. Exposure to SaaS or PE environments is a bonus Benefits Practical Ownership: Take responsibility for your own projects and gain valuable experience in FP&A at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company. Flexible Working: Flexible working hours that can be easily combined with your studies. Professional Development: An annual training budget of €750 to support your personal and professional growth. Wellbeing: Access to nilo.health as well as an additional Mental Health Day per year. Perks & Mobility: Subsidy for the Deutschlandticket or an Urban Sports Club membership. Team Culture: Regular team and company events, plus the opportunity to work with colleagues from over 40 nations. We mean it: With over 40 nationalities, we are united by our dedication and a shared belief in our purpose: to simplify mobility operations for businesses. Different backgrounds, career paths, and perspectives are what make the work better. What we care about is simple: people who take responsibility, make it happen, and care deeply about the work. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Show Production
jobs.description: The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality. You have a strong engineering mindset, deep curiosity about how complex systems behave, and practical experience testing audio software in real-world environments. You are comfortable working close to the code, designing robust test automation, debugging across software and hardware boundaries, and helping teams build products that are reliable, observable, and easy to validate. At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems. Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable. Your role and responsibilities As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test in this team, you will partner closely with software engineers and product designers to define test strategies, build automation, and validate complex workflows across desktop applications, audio plugins, networked audio systems, and spatial audio features. You will develop automated, scalable test frameworks, explore test infrastructure, and increase confidence in release cycles. You will work on both black-box and white-box testing approaches, depending on the problem: from backend-driven end-to-end tests to signal-analysis-based tests, UI validation, and system-level regression tests. You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite. You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior. You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows. What you need to succeed in this role Your skills and qualifications A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation. Professional experience in the audio industry, preferably overlapping with the following fields: desktop audio applications, audio plugins, Audio-over-IP, spatial audio and immersive sound experience, embedded audio systems. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
jobs.description: Hey! Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves. Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too. That's exactly what we're building every single day. Main information Start: Immediately Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote Workload: Full-time Team: Teamwear/Tech Is this a match? The most important basics – so we both know if it could work. 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome. Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering. Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus. Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap. Your playing field Here's why this role matters for our mission. Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person. As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope. Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope. How you'll make a difference This is how you move our mission forward every day. Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly. Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images. Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners. Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area. Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area. In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also: Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves. Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners. What you bring to the table We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points. Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis. Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing. Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling. Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams. Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way. 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it. Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit. Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked. Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews. Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs Good to know We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one. If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you. You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers. You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. jobs.title: Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst , you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production. To join our team, you should be excited to: Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve Build and maintain reliable, scalable data infrastructure Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production Your Qualifications An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is param

jobs.title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
jobs.description: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein. Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet. Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt. Das Team Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen. Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab. Deine Aufgaben Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt. Du baust den Auftritt. Standfläche, Standbau, Grafik, Technik, Logistik. Du verhandelst mit Messegesellschaften und Dienstleistern, hältst die Fristen ein und stehst vor Ort selbst am Stand. Du machst aus Standtagen Termine. Einladungskampagnen, Teilnehmerlisten, Matchmaking, Terminsetzung vorab. Danach: Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass und Übergabe an Sales entlang eines klaren SLA. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit. Landingpages, Formulare, HubSpot-Workflows, Lead-Tagging und Reporting baust du selbst — und berichtest MQLs, Pipeline und Signings je Event gegen Plan. Du bleibst nicht bei Events. Newsletter, LinkedIn, PR und eigene Formate gehören dazu, bis hin zu Guerilla-Experimenten wie Briefkampagnen oder OOH. Was funktioniert, wiederholen wir. Nach wem wir suchen Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie Du behältst den Überblick, wenn ein Dutzend Dienstleister und mehrere Messen parallel laufen – und eskalierst rechtzeitig Du denkst kaufmännisch und bewertest ein Event an dem, was es an Pipeline bringt Du baust dir Landingpage, Formular und Reporting selbst Bias to Action: lieber schnell testen und messen als lange konzipieren Deutsch muttersprachlich, gutes Englisch Berlin oder Umzug dorthin, plus Reisebereitschaft in der Messesaison und einen Führerschein Deine ersten 90 Tage: Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding Du hast trawas Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und Zielgruppe im Detail verstanden und alle relevanten Stakeholder in Marketing und Sales kennengelernt. Du hast das laufende Eventportfolio übernommen, kennst jeden offenen Punkt und jede Frist und hast die Abläufe dokumentiert. Du warst auf allen Messen vor Ort, die in dieser Zeit stattfanden, und hast konkrete Verbesserungen benannt und erste Verantwortung übernommen. Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen. Du hast die Planung für das kommende Halbjahr aufgesetzt, jedes Event durchgerechnet und einen Entscheidungsvorschlag vorgelegt. Ein wiederverwendbarer Ablauf steht: Vorlauf, Aktivierung, Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass — nachvollziehbar genug, dass jemand anderes ihn ausführen könnte.. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt habe

jobs.title: System Engineer (m/w/d) Open Source Collaboration & Kubernetes
jobs.description: Beschreibung: Das LRZ bearbeitet gemeinsam mit dem Regionalen Rechenzentrum Erlangen (RRZE) das Projekt BaySov. Ziel des Projekts ist die Evaluation souveräner, Open ‑ Source ‑ basierter Alternativen zu kommerziellen Cloud ‑ und Kollaborationsdiensten, um die digitale Unabhängigkeit bayerischer Hochschulen zu stärken. Für die Mitarbeit am Projekt BaySov zur Stärkung der digitalen Souveränität suchen wir dich als System Engineer (m/w/d) Open Source Collaboration & Kubernetes Das sind deine Aufgaben: Mitarbeit an einem strategisch bedeutenden und zukunftsweisenden Projekt für die digitale Zukunft bayerischer Hochschulen Möglichkeit, moderne Open-Source-Kollaborationsplattformen aktiv mitzugestalten Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum in einem innovativen technischen Umfeld Technische Evaluation von Kollaborations‑ und Groupware‑Systemen (openDesk, open-Xchange, grommunio etc.) Aufbau und Betrieb von Test‑ und Pilotumgebungen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Experten in zentralen Bereichen (Groupware, Kollaboration, Identity-Management) Das bringst du mit: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (Master-)Studium der Informatik / Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Erfahrung in Administration, Integration oder Entwicklung von Serverdiensten Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb containerisierter Anwendungen auf Kubernetes Erfahrung mit Infrastrukturautomatisierung und DevOps-Werkzeugen (z. B. GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD) Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren Bereichen: Groupware / Mail‑Systeme Linux-Systembetrieb, Containerisierung und Cloud-Native-Technologien Identity Management (SAML, LDAP, OIDC) Erfahrung mit oder Interesse an Open-Source-Infrastrukturen und souveränen IT‑Architekturen schnelle Auffassungsgabe und gute Teamfähigkeit Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und eine hohe Kundenorientierung Natürlich bieten wir für Berufsanfängerinnen und Wiedereinsteigerinnen eine fundierte Einarbeitung. Das ist unser Angebot: Bereich Email und Groupware Arbeitszeit Vollzeit (40 Std) Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell mit elektronischer Zeiterfassung Befristung Bis 30.04.2028, Weiterbeschäftigung wird angestrebt Vergütung möglich bis E 13, siehe Entgelttabelle TV-L Urlaub/Freizeit 30 Tage bzw. 6 Wochen im Jahr (24.12. + 31.12. zusätzlich arbeitsfrei) Überstunden werden durch zusätzliche Freizeit ausgeglichen Weiterbildungen Individuelle Unterstützung bei berufsbegleitenden Weiter- und Fortbildungen Mobile Arbeit Bis zu 60% der Arbeitszeit bei geeigneten Tätigkeiten Benefits z.B. 2er-Büros, JobRad, Bus und U-Bahn (U6) vor der Haustür, kostenfreier Parkplatz, Altersvorsorge der Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL), Arbeitsgeräte auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik Das erwartet dich am LRZ: Du suchst nach einer abwechslungsreichen und anspruchsvollen Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, kooperativen und innovativen Arbeitsumfeld? Dann bist du am LRZ genau richtig! Spannende Aufgaben im Dienst der Forschung, ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Miteinander, ein internationales, anregendes, diverses Unternehmensklima; flexibles Arbeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben und viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Das ist bei uns der Standard. Daneben bieten wir in unserem mit modernsten Komponenten ausgestatteten Rechenzentrum natürlich auch alle Vorzüge des öffentlichen Dienstes. Wir teilen Erfahrungen, prüfen und verbessern unsere Abläufe stetig und sind stolz darauf, dass die Qualität unserer Services und die Sicherheit der am LRZ gespeicherten Daten regelmäßig sehr gut bewertet und zertifiziert werden. jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your new team: Would you like to build Salesforce solutions that directly improve the experience of thousands of customers? At auxmoney, you will join a dynamic, cross functional team with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and a 360 degree view of the customer journey. You will work at the intersection of tech, product, and business, shaping scalable platform capabilities and reliable workflows that support one of Europe’s leading fintech platforms. What you can expect: Own end to end delivery: You architect, implement, and maintain high quality Salesforce solutions across Apex, Flows, LWC, and data models, and you take technical ownership from design to release. Build strong architectures: You apply clean architecture, testability, and performance best practices, and you raise the bar for maintainable code across the platform. Deliver great Salesforce UX: You design and optimize Lightning Web Components with strong performance, thoughtful interaction patterns, and a focus on usable, scalable experiences. Secure by design: You implement robust security and sharing concepts aligned with Salesforce’s security model, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field level security. Integrate with confidence: You design and implement integrations via REST and SOAP, platform events, and connectors with resilient patterns, strong authentication, and thorough error handling. Optimize for scale: You build within Salesforce governor limits and enforce best practices for bulkification, caching, transaction management, and async processing. Raise engineering standards: You define and champion platform standards, coding conventions, code reviews, and design guidelines as a trusted technical authority. Mentor and multiply impact: You coach junior and mid level developers through pair programming, structured knowledge sharing, and pragmatic guidance that improves team output. Partner across stakeholders: You collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Operations to translate complex business needs into scalable technical designs and delivery plans. Test for trust: You set expectations for meaningful unit and integration testing, and you help the team maintain strong, reliable coverage that supports safe delivery. Keep the platform reliable: You strengthen observability and maintainability through documentation, architectural decision records, and practical knowledge sharing. Work setup: You will work remotely within Germany, with collaboration routines that keep delivery fast, aligned, and transparent. Your profile Seasoned Salesforce development: You bring extensive hands on Salesforce development experience (8+ years) in enterprise environments and a track record of delivering impact at scale. Technical leadership: You are advanced in Flows and highly proficient in Apex and OOP, and you confidently choose the right approach across Flow, Apex, and configuration. Strong LWC expertise: You have deep experience with Lightning Web Components, including lifecycle, reactivity, performance optimization, and UI and UX best practices. Security and compliance mindset: You understand Salesforce’s security and sharing model and design for least privilege from the start. Integration skills: You connect Salesforce to external systems via REST and SOAP, OAuth, and named or external credentials, and you select suitable integration patterns for complex scenarios. Built for scale: You consistently apply best practices in governor limits, bulkification, transactions, async processing, and error handling, and you help others do the same. Delivery discipline: You work fluently with Git and pull requests, and you have hands on experience with CI and CD for Salesforce, for example Salesforce DX and GitHub Actions. Clear communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly in English and collaborate effectively in cross functional teams. Nice to have: You bring German skills, Salesforce certifications such as PD I or PD II,

jobs.title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Warum Wir? Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Das erwartet Dich Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören: Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten. Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten. Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen. Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs. Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern. Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen. Das bringst Du mit Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing. Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten. Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären. Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner). Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen. Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen. Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus. Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon. Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen: Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations. Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein. Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen). Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich. Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus

jobs.title: Senior Experience Manager – all genders welcome!
jobs.description: About the Job Du hast Lust, die Zukunft des Golfsports mitzugestalten? Dann komm in unser Team! Gemeinsam mit über 85 passionierten Mitarbeitenden sind wir fest entschlossen, die Golfbranche zu revolutionieren. Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n motivierte/n Senior Experience Manager (m/w/d), bereit, Teil unseres Unternehmens in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld zu werden. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du das gesamte Markenerlebnis rund um unsere Produkte über alle Touchpoints hinweg, von der Website über das Unboxing bis zur Produktpräsentation im Handel. Du etablierst moderne Tools und AI-gestützte Prozesse und entwickelst die Experience kontinuierlich weiter, eigenständig, datengetrieben und mit echtem Gestaltungsanspruch. Ready to embrace your Vice? Your Fairway Omnichannel Experience Optimierung der B2B Client Experience entlang des gesamten Order-Prozesses Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Experience über alle relevanten Touchpoints gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Experience Design & Trade Marketing Weiterentwicklung der Unboxing Experience: Verpackung, Beileger, Paket-Inhalte Zusammenarbeit mit CRM zu Angebotsflyern, Aktionen und regionalen Kampagnen im Paket Mitgestaltung der Produktpräsentation im Handel (Displays, POS-Erlebnis) Insights & kontinuierliche Optimierung Nach Produkt-Launches: Analyse der Top-Kundenanfragen und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit UI/UX und dem Website-Team (z. B. FAQ-Inhalte direkt auf die Produktseite) Systematisches Zurückspielen von Kundenfeedback aus Calls und Tickets an das Produkt-Team Aufbau eines CX-Reportings: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), Response Times, First Contact Resolution, Conversion aus Support-Kontakten Cross-funktionale Schnittstellen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, CRM, UI/UX, Produkt und Sales – mit klarer Abgrenzung, aber ohne Silodenken Du orchestrierst, statt zu verwalten: Impulse aus der Experience landen dort, wo sie Wirkung entfalten Your Scorecard Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (5+ Jahre) in Experience-, Brand- oder E-Commerce-/DTC-nahen Rollen, idealerweise im Consumer-Brand-Umfeld Starkes konzeptionelles und strategisches Denken – gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität Hohe Affinität zu modernen Tools: CRM-Systeme, Ticketing-Plattformen, AI-Lösungen im Customer Service Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung mit CX-KPIs und Reporting Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Stakeholder-Management über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg Eigenständige, proaktive Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Begeisterung für Golf ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss Our Clubhouse Wir fördern Vielfalt und Innovation – Unser kunterbuntes Team setzt sich aus Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft und verschiedenen Blickwinkeln zusammen, alle vereint durch eine frische, mutige Idee. Passe deine Arbeitszeiten deinem Leben an – Bleib flexibel mit unseren individuellen Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Optionen. Wachse gemeinsam mit uns – Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung ist uns wichtig, daher erwartet dich bei uns neben regelmäßigem Performance Feedback auch ein jährliches Weiterentwicklungs-Budget. Brich aus der Routine aus - Du hast die Möglichkeit, aus EU-Ländern deiner Wahl für insgesamt zwei Wochen pro Jahr remote zu arbeiten . Bleibe aktiv – Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher subventionieren wir EGYM Wellpass, sodass du für nur 30 € pro Monat trainieren kannst. Guad‘n! – Unser Foodji versorgt dich im Office mit einer abwechslungsreichen Auswahl an frischen Mahlzeiten und Snacks. Wir sorgen für Deine (ferne) Zukunft – Auch wenn der Ruhestand noch in weiter Zukunft scheint, wir bieten dir eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge an. Work hard play hard – perfektioniere dein Golfspiel und verfeinere deinen Schwung

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, AI/ML, Generative AI) - UK based
jobs.description: About Us Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We're a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian. We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world's largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences. As an award-winning Atlassian partner with a world-class team, we help organizations innovate and solve complex challenges for Fortune 500 companies and beyond, we want to hear from you. Opportunity We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to work closely with clients to identify, prototype, and deploy AI-powered solutions to real-world business challenges. This is a highly hands-on, customer-facing role combining AI engineering, software development, solution architecture, and consulting. You will work directly with users and stakeholders to understand their needs, rapidly build solutions, and iterate based on real-world feedback. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who is comfortable moving between customer conversations, architecture, coding, prototyping, and production delivery. Key Responsibilities Work directly with clients to understand business challenges, workflows, data, systems, and technical requirements. Translate ambiguous problems into practical AI and software solutions. Design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications, agents, copilots, and intelligent workflows. Integrate LLMs, Generative AI, APIs, enterprise systems, and data sources. Rapidly prototype solutions and validate them with users. Develop supporting APIs, services, data pipelines, and application infrastructure. Design scalable, secure, and maintainable technical architectures. Implement evaluation, monitoring, observability, and feedback mechanisms for AI solutions. Collaborate with product, data, engineering, and business teams to move successful prototypes into production. Communicate technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills Python — Strong software engineering and application development experience. Application Engineering — Experience building, testing, and deploying production applications. AI/ML Integration — Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications and workflows. APIs & System Integration — Experience with APIs, enterprise systems, third-party platforms, and data sources. LLMs / Generative AI — Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs and Generative AI. Cloud Platforms — Experience with AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. TypeScript — Experience developing modern applications or services. Agent Orchestration — Experience or understanding of AI agents, tool calling, agentic workflows, or orchestration frameworks. Customer-Facing / Consulting — Ability to work directly with clients and translate business problems into technical solutions. Solution Architecture — Ability to design end-to-end solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned to business objectives. Experience & Qualifications Typically 5+ years' experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience building and deploying AI/ML or Generative AI applications. Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with incomplete or evolving requirements. Ability to rapidly prototype and turn ideas into working software. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. A product-oriented mindset focused on solving the user's problem rather than simply delivering requirements. Ability to work independently within complex enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.  Know the Why : We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.  Innovate & Iterate : We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. Who You Are You're an experienced Staff Software Engineer and your adoption of AI has changed the scale of what you take on. You've taken initiatives that were ambiguous at the start, created structure where none existed, and driven them across teams to completion. You use what you build, and push for everyone around you to do the same. You judge your work by how much value reaches customers and how quickly. You make consequential calls with pragmatism and without close guidance, and you bring stakeholders and leadership with you. That judgment covers product direction as much as technical aspects. You have a strong record of delivering testable, evolvable, and scalable back-end architectures to production, and you thrive on the problems that come with them. You don't need to be a build expert, though you bring a deep understanding of and interest in the automation domain, as well as developer and AI agent productivity. You hold strong opinions, articulate them clearly, and change them when the evidence says so. Working in a distributed team suits you, and you can write concise documents that align everyone. Responsibilities Design, implement, test, deliver, and maintain Develocity features Own ambiguous initiatives, from discovery through production to proven impact Surface scope and delivery risk early across the initiatives you run, and drive the mitigation Write the discoveries and specifications that turn several teams' input into one coherent plan Set the standard in the day-to-day: the code you write, the reviews you give, and how you use AI Dogfood what you ship, and keep the practice strong across team

jobs.description: Location - Stockton-on-Tees / Remote About Everfield Everfield is a platform with a mission of acquiring, building and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth. Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries that provide mission-critical applications, services, and support to their clients. Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland and Spain About Fitfactory Fitfactory, part of the Everfield Ecosystem, helps factories become leaner, fitter and more productive through digital technologies. Providing smart, simple, modular MRP software underpinned by real-time business intelligence and expert guidance on digital transformation, we combine over 25 years' industry expertise with innovative technology to support more than 300 UK manufacturers on their digital transformation and help them be fit for the future. At Fitfactory, we believe in achieving more together and we are passionate about developing the talent within our business and supporting one another to achieve the very best for our customers. We believe in rewarding hard work and celebrate this with regular socials, events and internal awards. Job Summary We are looking for a commercially driven, self-reliant Sales Manager to generate, manage, and convert their own pipeline into new revenue. You will operate as an individual contributor within a high-performance sales team, taking full ownership of your pipeline—from prospecting through to close. You’ll play a key role in expanding our reach beyond our traditional SME manufacturing base into larger, more complex organisations, particularly with our next-generation ERP offering. You’ll report to the Business Development Manager and work closely with the wider sales function, but success in this role will come from your ability to independently create opportunities and consistently deliver against targets. As a core member of the department within a leading payment processing company, you will help drive operational excellence, scale our legal tech stack, and streamline workflows. The ideal candidate helps bridge the gap between legal expertise, technology, and data-driven efficiency. Workflow Optimisation: Evaluate existing legal processes, identify bottlenecks in the payment processing legal pipeline (e.g., merchant agreements, vendor contracts, regulatory tracking), and engineer streamlined, scalable workflows. Data Analytics & Reporting: Design dashboards and generate metrics within Jira and CLM tools to track legal spend, turnaround times, contract volumes, and team capacity. Present actionable insights to legal leadership. Vendor & Resource Support: Help manage relationships with legal tech vendors (e.g. Brightflag) and ensure the team is maximising the value of industry resources (e.g., CLOC, ACC). Required Experience & Qualifications Minimum of 1 year of experience in Legal Operations, ideally within a fintech, payment processing, or highly regulated corporate environment. Good working knowledge of Jira, specifically designing custom workflows, queues, and SLAs in JSM, helping manage Jira Spaces, and structuring documentation in Confluence. Experience using generative AI tools, prompt engineering, or AI-backed legal tech features to build efficiencies, automate repetitive tasks, and analyse legal data. General understanding of the legal operational challenges unique to payment processing, financial services, or tech companies. jobs.description: Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.   Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.   We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero. OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team   We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model.   Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions.   By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization. About the role We’re looking for a Data Engineer who can own the journey of data from source systems to decision-ready outputs. You’ll build and maintain pipelines, model data, stand up dashboards, and integrate systems via APIs. In a team this size, you’ll also get involved in application development - building internal tools with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX that put data directly in the hands of our investment and asset management teams.   In your first 3 months you’ll have taken ownership of at least one critical pipeline from an external system into Databricks, and built or materially improved a reporting layer used by Fund Management or Asset Management.   What you'll do Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines in Databricks, ensuring data is reliable, timely, and well-documented. Own and evolve our Databricks models - define schemas, enforce testing, and keep the warehouse clean. Automate manual data processes using Python, replacing spreadsheets and ad-hoc workflows with robust, repeatable jobs. Build performance dashboards and reports in Streamlit and HTMX (FastAPI) that Finance, Asset Management, and Fund Management actually use. Integrate internal and third-party systems via REST APIs, improving data accessibility across the business. Champion data quality - implement validation, monitoring, and governance practices that give stakeholders confidence in the numbers. Collaborate directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into data solutions.   What you'll need Strong SQL and Python skills, used daily for pipeline development, data modelling, and automation. Experience with modern data stack tooling: a cloud data platform (Databricks preferred), and version control (Git/GitHub). A solid understanding of data modelling, warehousing patterns, and ETL/ELT design. To be comfortable working with Postgres or similar relational databases. Clear communication - you can explain a data model to a fund manager and discuss trade-offs with an engineer. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. The Global Deal Desk sits between the sales team and closed revenue on every deal that runs through a formal procurement, security review, or RFP, which describes most of what TRM sells to governments, law enforcement, and financial institutions. Capture is the front half: engaging before an RFP exists, helping a customer define what they need, and positioning TRM as the answer rather than one of several responses to a fixed question list. Orchestrate the cross-functional work: sequence Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, and Customer Success so a complex pursuit converges on a date instead of arriving at one. As a Software Engineer, this takes the form of building and deploying applications that utilize the power of our physics AI models to enable our customers to build better, faster, and cheaper.</p> <div>As a member of the delivery team, you’ll work directly with customers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to develop applications that change the way advanced engineering is done. jobs.description: Detection alone is not security. Every day, security teams are forced to make critical decisions on incomplete data. Binalyze changes that. Our platform, AIR, gives investigators the full picture, turning alerts into understanding in minutes, not days. We’re scaling globally and building the category-defining investigation platform the industry has been missing. Partners are central to how we bring that value to market. We’re looking for a commercially driven Channel Account Manager to grow Binalyze’s VAR and reseller ecosystem, turning signed partners into active sellers and creating repeatable partner-led revenue. This is a hands-on commercial role, not a partner-programme administration role. You’ll build strong relationships with priority partners, create joint business plans, generate pipeline and help partners identify, progress and ultimately own Binalyze opportunities across their customer bases. What you’ll do Activate existing signed VAR and reseller partners and grow the partner ecosystem. Build commercial relationships with priority partners and their sales teams. Create and execute joint business plans with clear pipeline and revenue goals. Build mindshare so Binalyze is actively positioned by partner sellers. Identify, qualify and progress opportunities across partner customer bases. Work with Binalyze sellers on strategic joint opportunities where appropriate. Enable partners to identify, develop and close their own Binalyze opportunities over time. Recruit new partners selectively where there are clear capability, coverage or market gaps. Run regular partner pipeline and performance reviews. Measure success through active partners, partner-generated pipeline and partner-generated ARR. Coordinate with Binalyze technical teams to ensure partners receive effective technical enablement. What you’ll bring Proven channel, partner, alliances or indirect sales experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity or enterprise technology. A track record of activating VAR, reseller or MSSP partners and generating partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue. Experience creating and executing joint business plans, including pipeline, revenue targets and performance reviews. Strong commercial sales skills and the ability to coach partner sellers through qualification, deal progression and close. Confidence working with direct sales teams while maintaining a partner-first approach. The ability to build relationships with sales leaders and front-line sellers. A data-led approach to pipeline, conversion and ARR. Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. Nice to have Cybersecurity, digital forensics, incident response, SOC, EDR or related security-technology experience. Experience with MSSPs or security-focused VARs and resellers. Experience helping to build or scale an indirect sales motion in a high-growth SaaS business. Familiarity with CRM and partner-management tools. What we offer Generous annual leave plus wellbeing days and your birthday off. Private medical insurance, including family cover. Home office setup support. Monthly wellbeing and entertainment allowances. Wellbeing support through Oli. Fully remote and flexible working. Benefits are tailored by location; we’ll share full details during the hiring process. We’re committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. If you don’t meet every requirement listed, we’d still encourage you to apply. If this sounds like the kind of commercial challenge you’d like to spend your time on, we’d love to hear from you.
